results.description:
Anything you type twice belongs in KeepText.

Addresses. Bank details. The reply you send five times a week. Prompts, code,
links, your kid's allergy list. Save it once — then paste it anywhere, without
leaving the app you're in.


THE KEEPTEXT KEYBOARD

This is the one that changes the day-to-day. Switch to the KeepText keyboard
inside Mail, Messages, WhatsApp, Safari, Slack — anywhere you can type. Your
snippets are right there, ordered by what you actually use, so the one you
want is usually the first one. Tap it and the text lands at your cursor.

No app switching. No back-and-forth copy and paste. No losing your place.


SAVE IT IN UNDER A SECOND

- Share sheet — select text in any app, tap Share, choose KeepText. Done.
- Clipboard — copy something, open KeepText, and it offers to save it. One tap
  to keep, one tap to dismiss. It never reads your clipboard until you say yes.
- Type it — one field does both jobs. Search your library, and if nothing
  matches, that same field creates the snippet on the spot.


ONE TAP AWAY, EVERYWHERE ELSE TOO

- Widgets — home screen and lock screen. Tap to copy.
- Spotlight — swipe down anywhere and search your snippets by name.
- Shortcuts and Siri — "Save clipboard to KeepText," or add it to your Action
  button for one-press capture.


SEARCH THAT TELLS YOU THE TRUTH

Most apps guess. KeepText matches exactly — the word you typed, or the start
of it, and nothing looser. That sounds like a limitation until you use it: when
KeepText says nothing matched, it genuinely isn't saved yet, so you can create
it right there instead of wondering whether you're about to make a duplicate.


TEMPLATES

Put {{name}} or {{date}} anywhere in a snippet. When you use it, KeepText asks
you for the values and fills them in. Good for the email you send constantly
with one line that changes.


SYNCS EVERYWHERE. NO ACCOUNT. EVER.

Your snippets sync across your devices through your own iCloud account. There
is no KeepText account, no sign-up, no password, no server of ours in the
middle. Nothing to breach, because there's nowhere for your text to go.

The keyboard asks for Full Access because that is the only way iOS lets a
keyboard read the snippets stored on your own device. KeepText uses it for
exactly that. Nothing is collected, nothing is transmitted, there's no
analytics — the app has no account system to send anything to in the first
place. You can export everything you've saved to a plain JSON file whenever
you like.


FREE, THEN ONE SMALL PURCHASE

Keep up to 20 snippets free for as long as you want. One small purchase
unlocks unlimited snippets, forever. No subscription. No trial that quietly
starts charging. No ads.


NO FOLDERS

You'll notice there's no filing system. That's deliberate. Search and
frequency do the organizing, so saving something costs you one tap instead of
one decision — which is the whole reason your snippets actually get saved

Created based on years of scientific research in user interface, MessagEase is designed and optimized for use on a touchscreen device. 

MessagEase is a patented, innovative design different from the antiquated QWERTY keyboard. If you believe that every keyboard must be QWERTY-like, then MessagEase is not what you are looking for.

TabForge is an open-source programming keyboard for iPhone and iPad. Write code, scripts and terminal commands with punctuation and editing controls beside the letter keys.

Programming keys
- Type braces, square brackets, angle brackets, parentheses and full ASCII punctuation.

Layouts for your screen
Phone layouts keep familiar letter keys with coding controls close by. Compact landscape layouts leave more room for the app above the keyboard. Larger iPad and supported Duo layouts show more controls. Choose your key size and keyboard height, follow iOS light and dark appearance, or select a code palette.

Editing and input profiles
Use Code editor for pairing and indentation, Terminal · ANSI for supported control text, or Remote desktop for literal input. Terminal and remote behavior depends on the client: a keyboard extension inserts text and cannot send arbitrary hardware-key events. Line edits need enough context from the host app to verify the change.

Optional English prose autocorrect runs on the device in eligible text fields. Apple's spelling service finds misspellings, and TabForge picks the replacement from a bundled word list and the words around the cursor, weighing where you tapped. It is off by default, skips code-like input and stays inactive in Terminal, Remote desktop and the code playground. Space applies a correction; immediate Delete restores your spelling. An optional Learn my tap positions setting keeps average tap offsets for each key on this device to sharpen corrections. Turning it off erases them.

The companion playground
Edit text with syntax highlighting, line numbers, undo and a share action. The playground does not run code. Its keyboard, layout and theme screens change the installed keyboard's settings and snippets.

Voice to code lets you dictate, review spoken punctuation and insert the result. It requires microphone and Speech permission plus available on-device English recognition. Voice input runs in the companion app; iOS controls system Dictation availability.

Optional swipe typing uses a bundled English word list with word frequencies, programming words and names from the text around the cursor, with alternatives in the gear menu. It works offline, is off by default and remains experimental. Tap typing works better for some identifiers.

Optional support
TabForge is free. If you would like to support its development, the companion app's Tip Jar offers optional one-time purchases through Apple. Tips unlock no features and are not subscriptions.

Open source and privacy
TabForge is MIT licensed, with source and privacy details linked in the companion app. The keyboard does not log or transmit keystrokes. There are no ads, analytics or accounts.

Your IBAN. Your card number. Your tax ID. The things you retype twenty times a month, always from memory, always wrong the first time.

ClipCard saves them once and puts them on your keyboard. Open WhatsApp, Safari or your bank app, switch to the ClipCard keyboard, tap the clip. Done. Nothing retyped, nothing left sitting in your clipboard.

A KEYBOARD THAT CANNOT LEAK

Most keyboards ask you for Full Access, which is what lets a keyboard send whatever you type somewhere else. The ClipCard keyboard never asks, because it cannot: Full Access is switched off inside the extension itself, so iOS blocks it from the network completely. You can check it yourself in iOS Settings.

It reads an encrypted snapshot from the app, and the words next to your cursor so it can suggest the right clip. That text is matched in memory and thrown away: never stored, never logged, and with nowhere to go.

LOCKED, NOT JUST HIDDEN

* Face ID or Touch ID to open the app
* Unlock the app with Face ID and the keyboard opens with it, on every plan
* A 4 digit PIN when that session expires, or if your device has no biometrics
* AES-256-GCM encryption on everything the keyboard can see
* Masked previews: cards read **** 4242, wallets read 0x12...5678
* You choose clip by clip what reaches the keyboard. Card numbers are off by default. Recovery phrases, BIP39 passphrases and 2FA secrets never reach it at all.

WHAT YOU KEEP IN IT

IBANs, tax IDs, billing addresses, card numbers, phone numbers, links, crypto wallet addresses and plain notes. Ten data types, every one of them free.

IT FILLS ITSELF IN

* Copy something and ClipCard recognises what it is: card, phone, link or wallet address
* Scan a card with the camera and it captures the number, Luhn-checked before it is saved. You add the expiry date and CVV
* Card numbers are checked as you go (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover)
* Wallet address formats are recognised across Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana and TRON, and the chain is suggested. Always check an address against the original before sending funds
* Smart suggestions offer the right clip for the field you are in, decided on your iPhone and nowhere else

YOURS, ON EVERY DEVICE

Sync runs through your own iCloud. There is no ClipCard server, no account to create, no email to hand over. We could not read your data if we wanted to.

FREE MEANS FREE

* Unlimited clips. There is no cap, ever, on how much you save.
* All ten data types, camera scanning, Face ID, iCloud sync and search.

PRO ADDS
